ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a dashed square grid, and an oblique straight line passes near the grid point labeled P and extends toward the upper right. Observing the grid, it can be seen that when this oblique line starts from P and goes to a grid point in the upper right, it is approximately 5 squares to the right and 4 squares up, so the slope is 4/5. The three black triangles are all enclosed between this oblique line, some vertical grid line, and some horizontal grid line, and their positions correspond in order to the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd grid levels. Reasoning: Let P=(0,0), and take the grid side length as the unit, then the equation of the oblique line is y=(4/5)x. According to the positions of the three black triangles in the figure, the kth triangle corresponds to k=1,2,3, its left vertical side is on x=k, its top horizontal side is on y=k, and its hypotenuse is on the line y=(4/5)x. For the kth triangle, the vertical side length is k-(4/5)k=k/5; the horizontal side length is (5/4)k-k=k/4. Therefore the area is (1/2)(k/5)(k/4)=k^2/40. Substituting k=1,2,3, the ratio of the areas is 1^2:2^2:3^2=1:4:9.

raw_record.question_text: A little kangaroo draws a line passing through point $P$ of the grid and then paints three triangles in black as shown in the picture. The areas of these triangles are proportional to which numbers?

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: the slanted line passes through the grid point P and also through the grid intersection 5 columns to the right and 4 rows above P, so in grid coordinates with P=(0,0) the line has equation y=(4/5)x. The three black right triangles are located at the grid levels k=1,2,3: each has its left vertical side on x=k, its top horizontal side on y=k, and its hypotenuse on the slanted line. For the triangle at level k, the vertical leg is k - 4k/5 = k/5 and the horizontal leg is 5k/4 - k = k/4. Therefore its area is (1/2)(k/5)(k/4)=k^2/40. Substituting k=1,2,3 gives areas proportional to 1^2:2^2:3^2 = 1:4:9.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是虚线方格网，一条斜直线经过标有 P 的格点附近，并向右上方延伸。观察方格可见，这条斜线从 P 出发到右上方的一个格点时，大约是向右 5 格、向上 4 格，因此斜率为 4/5。三个黑色三角形都夹在这条斜线、某条竖直网格线和某条水平网格线之间，位置依次对应第 1、2、3 个网格层级。

推理：令 P=(0,0)，以网格边长为单位，则斜线方程为 y=(4/5)x。按图中三个黑三角形的位置，第 k 个三角形对应 k=1,2,3，它的左竖边在 x=k 上，顶横边在 y=k 上，斜边在直线 y=(4/5)x 上。对于第 k 个三角形，竖直边长为 k-(4/5)k=k/5；水平边长为 (5/4)k-k=k/4。因此面积为 (1/2)(k/5)(k/4)=k^2/40。代入 k=1,2,3，面积之比为 1^2:2^2:3^2=1:4:9。
